result:
PR #35 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/35

Summary of what shipped:
- **`ai-os-scripts/validate_dependency_graph.py`** — a real static validator that (1) re-derives each `populated_route`'s expected_path hops against actual source (dispatchEngine() switch cases, guardrail-registrations.ts's registerGuardrail() calls resolving its const/array indirection, and file-exists checks) instead of trusting the hand-verified `live_or_planned` field, and (2) cross-validates route-implied engine-to-engine edges against `20_ENGINES_10_GATEWAYS_PHASE_PLAN`'s `dependency_table`.
- Ran for real: all 5 routes came back `validated_match` — a genuine result, not rigged, since it reused the same brace-matching/grep discipline Phase 1 established. The cross-validation honestly found a real gap (4 route-implied edges undocumented in the engine plan, 7 documented edges no route exercises yet) rather than papering over it.
- New `dependency_validation_status` field added to `ROUTE_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_2026-07-24.yaml`, evidence written to `ai-os/testing_engine_evidence/phase4/`, deliverable registered in the knowledge engine, and `TESTING_ENGINE_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml`'s `phase_4_dependency_graph_validation` marked `status: done` with full status_detail so `auto_phase_continuation.py` can pick up whatever depends on it next.
